title.en: AN ACT AMENDING ACTS NUMBERED SIX HUNDRED AND THIRTY-EIGHT AND EIGHT HUNDRED AND FIFTY-THREE, BY PROVIDING THAT THE WORK THEREIN DIRECTED TO BE DONE MAY BE PERFORMED BY THE CONSULTING ENGINEER.
title.orig: AN ACT AMENDING ACTS NUMBERED SIX HUNDRED AND THIRTY-EIGHT AND EIGHT HUNDRED AND FIFTY-THREE, BY PROVIDING THAT THE WORK THEREIN DIRECTED TO BE DONE MAY BE PERFORMED BY THE CONSULTING ENGINEER.
title.vi: Đạo luật sửa đổi Đạo luật số 638 và 853 nhằm cho phép kỹ sư tư vấn thực hiện các công việc được quy định trong hai đạo luật đó
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแก้ไขพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่ 638 และฉบับที่ 853 โดยกำหนดให้งานที่ระบุไว้ในพระราชบัญญัติทั้งสองฉบับนั้นสามารถดำเนินการโดยวิศวกรที่ปรึกษา
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Undang-Undang Nomor 638 dan 853 dengan ketentuan bahwa pekerjaan yang diperintahkan di dalamnya dapat dilakukan oleh insinyur konsultan
title.ms: Akta mengubah Akta Nombor 638 dan 853 dengan menyediakan bahawa kerja yang diarahkan di dalamnya boleh dilaksanakan oleh jurutera perunding

text.en:
The survey of the Dalitiuan River at Botocan Falls and of the falls of the Caliraya and the Lomot
Rivers, as provided for in Acts Numbered Six hundred and thirty-eight and Eight hundred and fifty-three,
may be undertaken by the Consulting Engineer to the Commission in the absence of the electrical engineer
and the hydraulic engineer, authority for the appointment of whom is made in Act Numbered Six hundred
and thirty-eight and Eight hundred and fifty-three are hereby amended to this extent.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, October 5, 1903.
